# Theme 08 — Knot / Braid

**Working titles:** Seam Knot · Braid Collapse · Crossing Engine

**Role:** Tempting visual; weaker scientific fit.

---

## Fantasy

Nested terms look like knotted cords. Merges look like Reidemeister moves or
crossing cancellations. Scalars look like unknotted loops falling away.

---

## Why it feels attractive

Nested sandhi *looks* tangled. Players already know knots as “complicated
topology made simple by moves.” Trailers can be gorgeous.

---

## Why it is not the home phenomenon

| Knot language | Sandhi fact |
|---------------|-------------|
| Crossings / topology | Shared symbols + contraction |
| Isotopy invariants | Capelli pairing determinants |
| Reidemeister moves | Grade-gated rewrite + residual panel |

The engine identity is fermionic / exterior / Capelli — not knot polynomial
calculus. Using knots as the *claimed* science invites expert correction.

---

## Allowed use

- Ambient art, loading screens, one cosmetic board skin.
- “Looks knotted, is actually occupation” disclaimer in scientist mode.

## Disallowed use

- Marketing that says the game teaches knot theory.
- Levels whose win condition is a knot invariant rather than a sandhi normal form.

---

## Decision notes

Reject as primary theme. Keep as optional aesthetic garnish.
